The '''jamming beam''' was a weapon system developed just prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Similar to the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]], the jamming beam was a projection weapon that disrupted the fire control systems of the "painted" craft. Once "painted", attacking craft could attack their target unhindered by defensive fire.<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The jamming beam appeared in very few missions in ''TIE Fighter'', however was readily available in ''X-wing Alliance''{{'s}} multiplayer and skirmish modes.
